intro.text: A chasmfiend who leads the group of chasmfiends allied with the listeners.

items.text: Thundercloud was the first chasmfiend to choose not to fight the humans and listeners. His choice inspired around fifty others to make peace and join the listeners.
He was one of five chasmfiends who insisted on going with Venli's listeners through the chasms to Narak, lifting singers over obstacles with his mandibles.

At Narak he joined the listeners' staged attack on the humans. At Venli's urging he spared most of them, stomping through roofs and sweeping walls aside with his tail until they withdrew, with Venli riding on him.

appearance.text: The largest and most dangerous of the listeners' chasmfiends, with a face of thick plates like broken rock, dark eyes peering between them, and arm-thick mandibles he uses to carry people.

personality.text: Highly intelligent, he talks to chasmfiends and listeners through images and impressions and pulses rhythms Venli can feel. He follows listener commands and, though puzzled by not eating humans, trusts Venli's judgement.
